The asymptotic ratio follows directly from the source limit \(\Omega_N/(N+1)^2\to1/\varpi^2\).

value.rationale: The recent source advertises a better asymptotic constant, but finite horizons are the regime in which constant improvements are operationally meaningful and asymptotics alone do not exclude a crossover. The theorem shows that the exact new certificate is already better at every admissible even horizon, so the advertised constant advantage never has to wait for a sufficiently large iteration count. This is a natural finite-horizon comparison between the new method and the explicit state-of-the-art baseline used by the source, with a complete proof rather than a sampled numerical observation.
